root.label: Nepal plans four glacial lake drainage project

events.label: Nepal plans four glacial lake drainage project

slots.name: historical lake lowering
slots.sentence: In similar previous efforts, Nepal lowered by 3 m (10 ft) the level of the central Himalayan glacial lake of Tsho Rolpa by in 2000 and that of Imja in the vicinity of Mount Everest, the world's tallest peak, 10 years ago.

slots.name: outburst flood events
slots.sentence: Nepal, which has reported about 26 Glacial Lake Outburst Flood events in the past four decades, loses more than 300 lives and property worth millions of dollars to extreme climate events annually on average.

slots.name: plants devastated
slots.sentence: The latest floods devastated a dozen hydroelectric plants, roads, bridges, farms and settlements.

slots.name: lake elevation range
slots.sentence: The lakes, at heights ranging from 4,050 m to 5,483 m (13,280 ft to 18,000 ft), rank among Nepal's most potentially dangerous, the United Nations Development Programme and the International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (ICIMOD) said in a 2020 report.
